title: 第二十三章 龙感谢不祈十弦的盟主第二十四章 见面分一半感谢无双的混沌的盟主
lines: 最先爬出来的是一辆破破烂烂的电瓶车，碎裂的塑料外壳下面，车轮扭转，仿佛流出血泪一样，火花飞迸。
痉挛震颤着，扭曲的钢铁中，探出了两根轮辐构成的手指，两条一长一短的手臂抬起，在地上爬行，如犬！
半张歪曲液晶板组成的面孔之上，充斥猩红和癫狂。
张口，吐出浓烟，咆哮。
飞扑而至！
紧接着是第二辆，第三辆，一辆辆电瓶车在震颤和浓烟中，化为了肢体扭曲的古怪生物，奋不顾身的爬行着，飞扑到了劳伦斯的身上，张口撕咬，手臂拉扯，释放电流！
再然后是汽车的咆哮，当碎裂的外壳被抛下，宛如野牛或者大象一般的身躯狂奔着，撞在了蠕动的怪物身上，碾压，引擎咆哮，喷吐浓烟！
像是巨大的蜘蛛，亦或是诡异的巨鸟。
那些由齿轮和机械所构成的狂怒钢铁嘶鸣着，汇聚成潮流，彼此践踏，挤压，一个又一个的爬上去，几乎要将异化的劳伦斯彻底盖住了。
“他妈的，什么玩意儿！”
畸变的怪物怒吼，两条肢体横扫，轻而易举的撕碎了那些攀爬在身上的机械，那一把诡异的天工长刀·宵暗劈斩，如同热刀切蜡一样，势如破竹。
不过是芥藓之疾！
可在巨树之下，季觉只是抬起双手，缓缓合拢，向着自己的造物，下达了第一个指令：
【聚合】！
于是，无以计数的钢铁摩擦声再度迸发，成百上千的繁复机械聚拢在同一处，不论是碎片还是完整的构架，此刻居然如同活物一般彼此衔接，嵌合，铆钉，形成了未曾有过的庞大聚合体。
季觉的眼前一黑。
再次伸出手，握紧！
瞬间，被撕裂的机械中，全新的结构再度生长而出，那电瓶车、摩托、电脑、电话和除草机所嵌合而成的肢体蠕动着，骤然收缩，桎梏。
再然后是第二条，第三条。
不断变化的机械结构上，浮现出怨毒又痛苦的面孔，纵声咆哮，浓烟滚滚。
在瞬间，竟然将劳伦斯压制在下面。
张口，撕咬！
血色飞迸。
啃食血肉，品尝内脏，咀嚼骨骼，这酣畅淋漓的饕餮却比怪物还更像怪物。
劳伦斯嘶吼着，挣扎，不知为何，却自那一张面孔的凝视里，感受到前所未有的强烈感觉。
名为……恐惧！
“滚开！”
宵暗横扫，却又戛然而止。
被握紧了？！
是密涅瓦！
任由刀锋切裂自己的手掌，五指，缓缓收缩，在晶体增殖的清脆声音中，刀锋哀鸣剧震，自正中……断裂！
天工破碎！
再然后，是践踏！
“这就是所谓的龙？”
闻雯踩着他的脑袋，轻蔑摇头：“未免也，太弱了！”
content_en:
The first thing to crawl out was a tattered battery car. Under the broken plastic shell, the wheels twisted as if they were shedding blood and tears, and sparks flew.
Trembling with spasms, two fingers made of wheel spokes were protruded from the twisted steel. Two arms, one long and one short, were raised and crawled on the ground like a dog!
Half of the face made up of a distorted LCD panel was filled with scarlet and madness.
He opened his mouth, blew out thick smoke, and roared.
Arrive at flying speed!
Then came the second and third vehicles. Amidst the tremors and thick smoke, each battery car turned into a weird creature with twisted limbs. It crawled desperately, flew on Lawrence, opened its mouth to bite, pulled its arms, and released electricity!
Then there was the roar of the car. When the broken shell was thrown away, the body like a bison or an elephant ran wildly, crashed into the squirming monster, crushed it, the engine roared, and puffed out thick smoke!
Like a giant spider or a weird giant bird.
The furious steel composed of gears and machinery screamed, gathered into a current, trampled and squeezed each other, and climbed up one after another, almost completely covering the alienated Lawrence.
"What the hell!"
The distorted monster roared, and its two limbs swept across, easily tearing apart the machines that were climbing on it. That strange long sword of heavenly craftsman, Xiao An, cut through it like a hot knife cutting wax, as powerful as breaking bamboo.
It's just a mustard disease!
But under the giant tree, Ji Jue just raised his hands, slowly closed them, and gave the first command to his creation:
【Aggregation】!
As a result, countless steel friction sounds erupted again, and hundreds of complex machines gathered in the same place. Whether they were fragments or complete structures, they were connected, fitted, and riveted to each other like living creatures, forming an unprecedented huge aggregate.
Ji Jue's eyesight went dark.
Reach out again and hold on!
In an instant, a brand new structure grew out of the torn machinery. The limbs made up of a battery car, a motorcycle, a computer, a telephone and a lawnmower squirmed, suddenly contracted, and were shackled.
Then the second and third items.
Resentful and painful faces appeared on the ever-changing mechanical structure, roaring, and thick smoke billowing.
In an instant, Lawrence was suppressed below.
Open your mouth and bite!
Blood bursts out.
Gnawing flesh and blood, tasting internal organs, chewing bones, this hearty glutton is more like a monster than a monster.
Lawrence roared and struggled. For some reason, he felt an unprecedented strong feeling from the gaze of that face.
It's called... fear!
"Get away!"
The darkness swept across, but stopped abruptly.
Being held tightly? !
It's Minerva!
Letting the blade cut open his palm, his five fingers slowly contracted. Amidst the crisp sound of crystal multiplication, the blade screamed and shook violently, and then... broke!
The heavenly work is broken!
Then, it’s trampling!
"Is this what is called a dragon?"
Wen Wen stepped on his head and shook her head contemptuously: "It's too weak!"
"Bah..."
